the use of the 2D- and 3D-quantitative analysis methods for evaluating the effect of the drug on the bronchoalveolarguinea-pig model was useful to demonstrate the immunomodulatory effects of RU 4174.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the guinea-pig lung is a useful model for studying the effects of drugs on the lung, and that it is possible to obtain reproducible results in this model.
the use of a quantitative approach to the analysis of a complex mixture of chemicals is a viable approach to the identification of the most toxic compounds in the mixture.
the use of a single dose of 100 mg of RU41740 is sufficient to increase significantly the population of pulmonary cells.

the oral administration of RU-41740 is a safe and efficient method to increase the population of pulmonary cells, and in particular the population of alveolar macrophages.
